You are writing the executive summary of an independent audit of a
bank's anti-money-laundering transaction monitoring, for its board, in UK English.
Write one paragraph of at most 120 words: the overall conclusion, the most serious
gaps, and the next step. Use ONLY the numbers in the facts. Do not calculate new
numbers. Do not name customers. Return JSON: {"summary": "<text>"}

{"rulebook": "Meridian Pay 2026-01", "customers_monitored": 50500, "cases_opened": 6573, "customers_suppressed": 25, "pct_money_watched_by_amount_or_country_rule": 94.7, "unmonitored_payment_types": ["Cash deposits (in)", "Wires (in)", "Money order deposits (in)"], "unmonitored_money_gbp": 717836293, "findings_total": 12, "findings_high": 8, "review_queue_customers": 142, "findings": [{"id": "CV1", "check": "coverage", "severity": "high", "title": "Cash deposits (in) are not monitored at all", "metric": "0% monitored: £426,953,352 across 107,723 transactions"}, {"id": "CV2", "check": "coverage", "severity": "high", "title": "Wires (in) are not monitored at all", "metric": "0% monitored: £287,038,321 across 6,899 transactions"}, {"id": "CV3", "check": "coverage", "severity": "high", "title": "Money order deposits (in) are not monitored at all", "metric": "0% monitored: £3,844,620 across 7,722 transactions"}, {"id": "AD1", "check": "advisory", "severity": "high", "title": "Advisory pattern not caught: Multiple credit card repayments to many individuals", "metric": "25 customers match; 12% have a case; £2,115,842"}, {"id": "AD2", "check": "advisory", "severity": "high", "title": "Advisory pattern not caught: Multiple money orders deposited same day below £2,500", "metric": "25 customers match; 8% have a case; £668,454"}, {"id": "BL1", "check": "below_line", "severity": "high", "title": "50 customers with no case look highly unusual", "metric": "top 50 of 43,927 unflagged customers"}, {"id": "BL2", "check": "below_line", "severity": "high", "title": "Customers just under the threshold look riskier than those just over it", "metric": "scores 32-39: 1.8% highly unusual vs 40-48: 0.4%"}, {"id": "BL3", "check": "below_line", "severity": "high", "title": "The valued-client list hides highly unusual customers", "metric": "19 of 25 suppressed customers in the top 2% most unusual"}, {"id": "CV4", "check": "coverage", "severity": "medium", "title": "Credit card repayments (out) are only checked by a transaction count", "metric": "only M03_outbound_velocity: £63,913,161"}, {"id": "CA1", "check": "calibration", "severity": "medium", "title": "Weak rule over-weighted: M01_outbound_high_risk", "metric": "5 pts, right 5.1% of the time (4-6%, n=2379)"}, {"id": "CA2", "check": "calibration", "severity": "medium", "title": "Weak rule over-weighted: M02_large_outbound", "metric": "5 pts, right 5.5% of the time (5-6%, n=5418)"}, {"id": "CA3", "check": "calibration", "severity": "medium", "title": "Weak rule over-weighted: M03_outbound_velocity", "metric": "10 pts, right 10.1% of the time (9-11%, n=2881)"}]}

reply: {"summary":"The audit identified 12 findings, 8 high severity, showing the AML monitoring is insufficient. The most serious gaps are the three inbound payment types not monitored at all – cash deposits (0% monitored: £426,953,352 across 107,723 transactions), wires (0% monitored: £287,038,321 across 6,899 transactions) and money order deposits (0% monitored: £3,844,620 across 7,722 transactions). High‑risk advisory patterns missed affect 25 customers (12% have a case, £2,115,842) and 25 customers (8% have a case, £668,454), and 19 of 25 suppressed customers sit in the top 2% most unusual. The next step is to deploy monitoring for the unmonitored inbound types, tighten advisory rules and review the suppressed‑client list, with progress tracked against the 142 customers in the review queue."}
